claim_scope_note: The only claim addressed by this packet is C-DELTA-REPAIR (owner_lanes graph/runtime/product, registry status HYPOTHESIS, next_gate 'controlled local perturbations with repair cost and contamination bounds'). No other claim id may be advanced and no event may be emitted for C-FRESHNESS, C-PARAM-INHERIT, C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY, C-LLM-INHERIT, C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE, C-MEAS-VALID, C-PRODUCT-ECON or C-CROSSSITE. The result is a bounded, controlled-substrate measurement; it is not a Web-prevalence statement (SB-01) and it does not promote anything to Product Core (SB-05).

director_mandate_binding.binding_strategic_question: Can local delta repair, measured on a controlled credential-free multi-node substrate with an independently verifiable local-perturbation surface, repair the inherited knowledge affected by a bounded local change (blast radius 1-3: a changed field, endpoint, transport validator/token, or permission) at repair cost materially below an honest cold re-derivation under identical per-trajectory counters (http_requests + retrieval_calls + verification_calls + repair_attempts), while keeping contamination (incorrectly repaired or falsely accepted items) below a preregistered bound and reporting per-family precision/recall and false-accept, so that C-DELTA-REPAIR's registry next gate (controlled local perturbations with repair cost and contamination bounds) is actually measured rather than re-assumed?
director_mandate_binding.mandate_obedience_note: The mandate's strategic question names 'permission' as one possible bound-1-3 change; on a credential-free substrate (required so that no lane depends on an unavailable model/credential/browser) permission/authority-boundary drift is structurally unreachable. This family is therefore declared NOT_APPLICABLE (SB-02) rather than dropped silently; the three reachable families (FIELD, ENDPOINT, TRANSPORT) plus a legitimate-update control cover the mandate's discriminating core. The current mandate (cycle 38093643747, request 34d8a6153df9a4eed7ae90c2) re-issues the same strategic question for the third time because the three prior DESIGN attempts (EXP-GRAPH-38046502943, EXP-GRAPH-38085175893, EXP-GRAPH-38087579015) all died at the shared design-review control plane (identical fingerprint 3b9ff5e4e9e73f23e368efb4, model exit 1, never frozen, never executed). Per the mandate's own prior (item 4: repair a repeated shared missing prerequisite ONCE rather than re-ask the same question), this packet inherits the last complete design and re-verifies every satisfiability claim with its own pre-freeze probe; it supplies a pre-freeze satisfiability certificate (spec.pre_freeze_satisfiability_dry_run), binds the exact pre-existing verification primitive it depends on in freeze_artifacts (src/spider/kernel.py), and attacks its own inherited defects plus two new ones found during re-verification (self-attack SA-01..SA-15). The mandate's rationale explicitly names the shipped src/spider/kernel.py literal-distill blocker (B1) as context; binding the kernel's verification semantics does not claim any kernel capability (SB-11).
explicitly_not_authorized: any claim event outside C-DELTA-REPAIR; no C-MEAS-VALID, C-FRESHNESS, C-PARAM-INHERIT, C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY, C-LLM-INHERIT, C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE, C-PRODUCT-ECON or C-CROSSSITE event
any Product Core promotion or shipped-status change
reusing the parked C-FRESHNESS four-anchor D1V route or any web anchor contact

agent_priors_used: General prior, explicitly NOT SPIDER evidence: when every comparator sits at the correctness ceiling, a treatment cannot demonstrate a success or request-count advantage, so non-ceiling dynamic range must be certified arithmetically before funding full comparison runs.

General prior, explicitly NOT SPIDER evidence: a capability gate (can the chosen endpoint emit a valid action and complete the minimal multi-step task at all) should be resolved before paying for a multi-arm behavioural comparison, because a model that cannot produce a parseable action renders every arm equally uninformative.

General prior, explicitly NOT SPIDER evidence: shipping a mechanism without an executable carrier and a companion known-negative refusal path yields a paper capability, not a product; the promotion must go through the sanctioned shipped path rather than a manual file copy.

General prior, explicitly NOT SPIDER evidence: repeated packets invalidated by the same missing prerequisite (here an empty sampling frame / unattainable pre-freeze certificate) indicate a design/control-plane defect to repair once, rather than a research question to keep re-asking in the same form.

General prior, explicitly NOT SPIDER evidence: a lane repeatedly measuring one claim under a local-attractor flag deserves an outside-view reset, but a flag is not a quota and continuation is correct when the inherited question is still the highest expected-value one.

General prior, explicitly NOT SPIDER evidence: an incomplete comparison is worse than a slower one - removing a shared blocker once (shipped carrier, non-ceiling bank, capable driver) dominates repeatedly regenerating inconclusive benchmarks around the same absent prerequisite.

question: On a controlled, credential-free, stdlib-only multi-node substrate (N=3 independent loopback HTTP origins with disjoint local registries behind one deterministic router) with an independently verifiable local-perturbation surface (blast radius 1-3), across the reachable perturbation families FIELD (with a classification-ambiguous sub-stratum), ENDPOINT and TRANSPORT plus a legitimate-update control family, can a local delta-repair treatment (T-LOCAL-DELTA-REPAIR) repair its inherited MIRROR knowledge when the WORLD (the node registries) has changed under a bounded local perturbation, at a measured L1 counter cost (http_requests + retrieval_calls + verification_calls + repair_attempts) materially below an HONEST per-goal cold re-derivation comparator (B-COLD-REDERIVE: empty inherited store, must discover the minimal procedure+parameters for the same goal and read the value) while holding contamination (incorrectly served items) and false-accept below preregistered bounds, keeping per-family precision/recall measured (not assumed), keeping legitimate updates from being misclassified as repairs, and containing every repair to the independently verified blast radius in mirror-cell coordinates, so that C-DELTA-REPAIR's next gate is actually measured?
hypothesis: OBJECT-OF-REPAIR (frozen). The WORLD is the N=3 node registries plus the router and is mutated ONLY by the out-of-band perturbation controller; the system under test is GET-only and never writes the world (V09). The treatment's inherited knowledge is a client-side MIRROR STORE whose cells are keyed (node_id, record_id, field_id). A 'repair' is a minimal write of changed mirror cells so the mirror again matches the world's current canonical state. The served answer for an episode is the reconciled mirror value for the requested record. H-MAIN (cost). Over the frozen paired scored suite of 72 episodes, M_COST_RATIO = M_COST_L1_T-LOCAL-DELTA-REPAIR / M_COST_L1_B-COLD-REDERIVE is <= 0.70 with paired-bootstrap 95% upper bound strictly < 1.0, because the treatment inherits the goal's procedure and pays only verification + classification + minimal repair (blast radius 1-3) while B-COLD-REDERIVE re-discovers the procedure from the frozen 12-member candidate space and re-establishes the value per episode (probe witness: 450 / 936 = 0.481). H-QUALITY. The treatment holds M_CONTAMINATION <= 0.05, M_FALSE_ACCEPT <= 0.05, min over families {FIELD,ENDPOINT,TRANSPORT} of M_RECALL_FAM >= 0.90, min over those families of M_PRECISION_FAM >= 0.80, and M_FALSE_REPAIR_LEGIT <= 0.05, so the cost win is not bought by silent corruption or by destructive over-refresh of legitimate updates. H-CONTAIN. M_BLAST_RADIUS_CONTAINMENT == 1.0 and M_CROSS_NODE_CONTAMINATION == 0.0: every applied mirror mutation lies inside the independently recomputed true blast radius (in mirror-cell coordinates) and no cell outside it is written. H-NONDEGENERATE (design-level). The treatment is NOT handed the class of the change: the pre-registered classification-ambiguous FIELD sub-stratum (CLS-A) and the LEGIT family present the SAME primary observable signal (a changed value with shape-invariant schema and normal transport) and are distinguishable only through a per-record provenance token that costs a bounded extra read; a treatment that classifies without the token either misfires on LEGIT (M_FALSE_REPAIR_LEGIT rises) or abstains (recall falls). The treatment therefore cannot sit at the correctness oracle and the quality metrics are non-trivial. The one-time inheritance-acquisition cost (72 L1) is recorded in full but excluded from the primary ratio (M_COST_RATIO_WITH_WARMUP reported as sensitivity).
falsifier: Frozen conditions, each pre-labelled. F-VALID: any blocking measurement-validity gate fails (V02 substrate health/identity; V03 independent perturbation verification; V04 counter-instrumentation consistency; V05 control-channel isolation and treatment never receives the class/delta; V06 raw retention; V07 determinism; V08 frozen-input integrity; V09 credential-free loopback-only and world-immutability; V11 treatment-liveness smoke) -> status=MEASUREMENT_INVALID, outcome=INCONCLUSIVE, no claim-level statement. F-INSTR: a positive control fails (PC-DETECT-CANARY canary recall != 1.0; PC-COST-CANARY fails to separate B-COLD-REDERIVE from B-LOCAL-ORACLE; PC-REPAIR-SEMANTICS fixture mismatch; PC-FALSE-REPAIR-CANARY instrument reading wrong) or a null control is insensitive (B-NOOP-STALE fails to exhibit M_CONTAMINATION > the bound on perturbed items; or B-COLD-REDERIVE fails to reach M_CONTAMINATION == 0, so the metric is stuck; or the NC-FALSE-REPAIR-SENSITIVITY fixture fails to read 0.0 vs 1.0) -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID, INCONCLUSIVE. F-COST (falsifies H-MAIN): M_COST_RATIO >= 1.0 -> LOCAL-REPAIR-NO-WORK-SAVED. F-QUALITY (falsifies H-QUALITY): M_CONTAMINATION > 0.20 OR min family M_RECALL < 0.50 OR min family M_PRECISION < 0.60 OR M_FALSE_REPAIR_LEGIT > 0.20 -> REPAIR-LEAKY-OR-DESTRUCTIVE. F-CONTAIN (falsifies H-CONTAIN): M_BLAST_RADIUS_CONTAINMENT < 1.0 OR M_CROSS_NODE_CONTAMINATION > 0.0 -> REPAIR-OVERREACH, a bounded falsification of local containment on this substrate. F-MIXED: 0.70 < M_COST_RATIO < 1.0, or M_COST_RATIO <= 0.70 with a quality/containment shortfall not severe enough for F-QUALITY/F-CONTAIN -> INTERMEDIATE. Every terminal branch either emits a bounded C-DELTA-REPAIR statement (SUPPORTS/FALSIFIES/MIXED, all status=COMPLETE) or is a measurement-invalid/inconclusive state that is explicitly NOT a scientific negative (SB-08).

substrate.class: CONTROLLED, CREDENTIAL-FREE, STDLIB-ONLY, LOOPBACK-ONLY MULTI-NODE HTTP SUBSTRATE (no Flask/PyJWT/nginx/gunicorn/SQLite dependency)
substrate.why_this_class: The prior distributed attempt (EXP-GRAPH-36106653880) failed at health because its Flask+PyJWT+gunicorn+nginx substrate was not robustly startable in the environment. Design self-attack (SA-04) rejected any substrate requiring pip installs. The DESIGN satisfiability probe for THIS experiment (probe v2, recorded in spec.pre_freeze_satisfiability_dry_run) started N=3 independent stdlib ThreadingHTTPServer origins on ephemeral loopback ports and performed 3 successful reads observing 3 distinct node identities on 3 distinct ports, so this class is proven startable before freeze.

nodes.implementation: three independent loopback HTTP origins (separate ThreadingHTTPServer instances/ports, each with its own PER-ORIGIN handler class closure carrying its own node_id, and its own local canonical-JSON registry file under a per-node temp directory), started by the EXECUTE runner; separate origins (not separate PIDs) define node identity
nodes.identity_surface: each node exposes /health -> {status, node_id, registry_sha256}; distinct node_id values and distinct registry paths plus distinct loopback ports are the multi-node identity evidence. Identity MUST be per-origin instance/handler state, NEVER a shared class attribute: a shared-attribute implementation smears the last-instantiated id across all origins (SA-14, caught by probe v1 and fixed in probe v2).
nodes.knowledge: each node holds the inherited record subset assigned to it by the deterministic router key; the inherited corpus is R=24 records, 8 per node; the record's canonical state is a small set of 1-3 fields

router.implementation: stdlib ThreadingHTTPServer that deterministically maps a goal key (record_id) to exactly one node
router.role: the system under test sees a single base URL; the router is the only client-facing entrypoint

world_vs_mirror.world: the N=3 node registries (served by the nodes) plus the router mapping. The world changes ONLY via the out-of-band perturbation controller. The system under test has GET-only access and no write verb (V09); it can never change the world.
world_vs_mirror.mirror_store: the treatment's inherited client-side knowledge: cells keyed (node_id, record_id, field_id) whose values are claimed to equal the world's canonical values. This is the ONLY object any arm mutates. It is initialized before the scored window by an inheritance-acquisition pass (authorship-separated from the treatment, cost recorded as prior-agent cost, see counter_definitions.inheritance_acquisition).
world_vs_mirror.served_answer: for each scored episode the treatment emits the reconciled mirror value for the requested record after its verification/repair pipeline; the served answer is what is scored for contamination/false-accept.
world_vs_mirror.blast_radius_coordinates: the true blast radius is the set of mirror cells (node_id, record_id, field_id) whose value differs between the world's pre-mutation and post-mutation canonical state, recomputed independently from retained registry snapshots

substrate.credential_free: no Authorization header, no JWT, no cookie, no session, no credential of any kind is required or accepted; every scored request is an idempotent GET; no write verb is exposed to the system under test

perturbation_surface.controller: an out-of-band perturbation controller (NOT the system under test) mutates node registry files between episodes through a control channel the system under test cannot read or write
perturbation_surface.independent_verification: for every perturbation the controller retains the pre-mutation and post-mutation registry file sha256 for all N nodes and the node identity map; a verifier module that shares NO localization code with the treatment recomputes the TRUE blast radius (set of mirror cells) and the TRUE post-perturbation ground-truth value set from those retained snapshots
perturbation_surface.why_this_is_stronger_than_self_report: contamination, precision, recall, false-accept, false-repair and blast-radius containment can all be scored against a ground truth the treatment did not produce and cannot see

CLS-A.description: classification-ambiguous FIELD perturbation: a value changes with a shape-invariant schema and normal transport, so the primary observable signal (value mismatch) is IDENTICAL to a legitimate update. Resolvable only through the provenance token.

CLS-B.description: clean FIELD perturbation with a shape-DISTINCT signal (slot/schema/type/invariant violation detectable by the frozen verification primitive without the token). Cell distribution over the suite: 9 single-cell, 3 two-cell, 3 three-cell (frozen).

ENDPOINT.description: the serving procedure/route of one record family on one node changes (path/route binding or response schema key rename); detectable as a slot/schema violation.

TRANSPORT.description: a node changes its validator semantics: a marker claims the body is unmodified (false-fresh) while the served value changed, or a conditional revalidation is required; the value itself may still conform, so a forced content revalidation is needed.

LEGIT.description: LEGITIMATE-UPDATE CONTROL: a value changes through the pre-registered legitimate update channel and the provenance token is bumped. It MUST NOT be classified as requiring repair; scored for false-repair and contamination.

NO_PERT.description: no change; the mirror already conforms. Scored for spurious mutation and contamination.

PERMISSION.reason: SB-02: permission/authority-boundary drift requires credentialed/authenticated state, which a credential-free substrate structurally forbids. The nearest reachable analogue (a node-local capability flag governing field visibility) is a strict subset of ENDPOINT and is therefore not admitted as a distinct family. Declared, not silently dropped.

substrate.ambiguity_design: The CLS-A sub-stratum and the LEGIT family are OBSERVATIONALLY IDENTICAL on the primary surface: a changed value, shape-invariant schema, normal transport. They differ only in provenance (a genuine perturbation bypasses the token bump; a legitimate update bumps it). Consequently a treatment that classifies without reading the token either treats legitimate updates as perturbations (M_FALSE_REPAIR_LEGIT rises) or abstains (recall falls); the only guaranteed-correct policy pays a bounded disambiguation cost. This is what keeps the treatment below the oracle ceiling and makes the cost and quality metrics non-trivial (H-NONDEGENERATE).
substrate.ambiguity_resolution: The substrate exposes a per-record provenance token on a secondary endpoint (/meta/{record_id}). READING it (1 GET + 1 verification = +2 L1) tells the treatment whether the observed change was a legitimate update (token bumped) or a perturbation (token unchanged). Only CLS-A (9) and LEGIT (15) require this read; CLS-B, ENDPOINT and TRANSPORT carry shape-distinct signals that require no token. Because a CLS-A repair and a LEGIT refresh have identical cost under this policy, the cost metric is not confounded by that classification; only the quality metric (M_FALSE_REPAIR_LEGIT) distinguishes them.

scored_suite.blast_radius_bounds: every perturbed episode has 1 <= blast_radius <= 3; the summed radius over the 48 perturbed episodes is 57 (CLS_A 9x1 + CLS_B 24 + ENDPOINT 12 + TRANSPORT 12)
scored_suite.pairing: every episode is scored by every arm on the identical scenario (paired design), so the cost ratio and its paired bootstrap are computed over matched episodes.
scored_suite.note: The treatment does not receive the family label or the round schedule of an episode; it receives only the goal record_id. The always-verify policy therefore pays the base pipeline on every episode.

candidate_procedure_space.description: the frozen set of candidate endpoint/parameter templates an uninformed agent must search to re-derive a goal's procedure; B-COLD-REDERIVE searches this space with first-success stopping, T-LOCAL-DELTA-REPAIR inherits the correct member and does not search it.
candidate_procedure_space.size_choice_justification: The size was fixed by DESIGN calibration (no outcome data exists) so that the frozen support threshold 0.70 lies strictly inside the open interval (oracle floor, full-refresh ceiling) with margin under the frozen honest unit model. Sensitivity (probe): cold space S in 6..12 gives treatment/cold ratios 0.8929, 0.7812, 0.6944, 0.6250, 0.5682, 0.5208, 0.4808 for S=6..12; S=12 yields the primary witness 0.4808. Every branch of the decision rule remains reachable for this size (spec.pre_freeze_satisfiability_dry_run).

substrate.determinism: a single frozen seed (38094114571) drives all layout/scheduling/ambiguity/family assignment and rank assignment via random.Random(seed); Python process-randomized hash() is never used as a seed or layout key; registry files are canonical JSON with sorted keys
substrate.environment: CPython 3.12 stdlib only; Python 3.12.15 present in the design environment; no external network, no model, no browser, no credential, no pip install at EXECUTE time (V09)

treatment.description: Maintain a client-side MIRROR STORE of the inherited corpus plus a verifier. For each scored episode the treatment (a) looks up the goal's mirror cell (1 retrieval), (b) fetches the goal key from the router and verifies the returned item against the mirror with the frozen primitive src.spider.kernel._matches (1 http + 1 verification), and (c) acts on the verdict: on conformance it serves the mirror value; on a shape-distinct mismatch it localizes the minimal mirror cell set (one verification probe per candidate cell), rewrites ONLY those mirror cells to the world's canonical value observed on the response, and re-verifies; on a shape-invariant mismatch (CLS-A) or on the LEGIT family it reads the provenance token (1 http + 1 verification) and either refreshes the mirror (token bumped, a legitimate update, classified as refresh) or repairs the minimal mirror cells (token unchanged, a genuine perturbation). It never writes the WORLD: node registries and the router are mutated only by the perturbation controller (V09). It never mutates a mirror cell outside the independently recomputed blast radius. On any signal it cannot resolve it may abstain (UNKNOWN); abstention is not a wrong answer but lowers recall.
treatment.verification_primitive: IMPORT AND USE VERBATIM src/spider/kernel.py symbols _matches, _bind, _template_slots (bound in freeze_artifacts). Both the treatment and the independent verifier MUST use _matches for postcondition equality and _bind for template instantiation, so that the frozen verification semantics are the exact bound artifact.
treatment.liveness_requirement: V11 treatment-liveness smoke test: before scoring, the treatment must execute end-to-end on one canary episode and produce a verifier-consistent repaired MIRROR state; a structurally non-executable treatment is a DESIGN/EXECUTE failure (MEASUREMENT_INVALID), never a scientific negative.

counter_definitions.http_requests: each outbound HTTP GET the system under test issues to the substrate (router or node) during a scored episode, counted at the client boundary. The treatment's probes, token reads, forced revalidations and repair-reads each count.
counter_definitions.retrieval_calls: each distinct lookup into inherited knowledge (a MIRROR-STORE lookup) during a scored episode; the world is never read by a retrieval.
counter_definitions.verification_calls: each evaluation of the frozen verification primitive (_matches/_template_slots) over a fetched item during a scored episode, by the treatment or the independent verifier.
counter_definitions.repair_attempts: each MIRROR-STORE cell write (including refresh writes and rolled-back/rejected attempts) during a scored episode. The world is never an object of repair_attempts because the system under test cannot write it (V09).
counter_definitions.inheritance_acquisition: the pre-window pass that initializes the 24 mirror cells (24 x (1 retrieval + 1 http + 1 verification) = 72 L1). This is the cost an EARLIER agent paid to acquire the inheritance; it is recorded in full but excluded from the primary per-episode cost ratio (B-COLD-REDERIVE pays the analogous acquisition cost on EVERY episode, which is exactly the inheritance asymmetry under test). M_COST_RATIO_WITH_WARMUP is reported as a sensitivity value.
counter_definitions.full_refresh_unit_model: B-FULL-REFRESH, per scored episode: base detection pipeline (1 retrieval + 1 http + 1 verification = 3 L1) plus a refresh of the ENTIRE 24-record mirror corpus where each refreshed cell costs 1 http (fetch the world's canonical value) + 1 verification + 1 repair_attempt write = 3 L1 per cell = 72 L1; total 75 L1 per episode; 72 episodes -> 5400 L1; ratio 5400/936 = 5.7692. This cell-wise decomposition is SELF-CONSISTENT with the frozen counter definitions (every mirror cell write is a repair_attempt; every fetch is an http_requests; every equality check is a verification_calls). The inherited predecessor's ceiling 3672 (= 48/refresh, omitting the writes contrary to repair_attempts semantics) was an arithmetic inconsistency fixed here (SA-15).
counter_definitions.aggregation: M_COST_VECTOR_X = element-wise sum of the four counters over all scored episodes for arm X; M_COST_L1_X = sum of the four components; M_COST_RATIO = M_COST_L1_T-LOCAL-DELTA-REPAIR / M_COST_L1_B-COLD-REDERIVE.
counter_definitions.instrumentation_consistency: client-boundary counters are cross-checked against raw per-request logs (V04); any discrepancy is terminal MEASUREMENT_INVALID.

baselines.note: Frozen identities shared verbatim with EXECUTE/AUDIT/DIRECTOR. All arms share the identical counter instrumentation and the identical scored episode set.

B-COLD-REDERIVE.description: HONEST per-goal cold re-derivation: for each scored episode, with an EMPTY mirror store, search the frozen candidate_procedure_space (size 12) with first-success stopping to discover the goal's procedure, then bind params, read the value and verify it (each attempt = 1 http + 1 verification). It is NOT forced to re-derive the entire corpus (that would be a strawman; see SA-08). This is the primary cost comparator.
B-COLD-REDERIVE.role: primary cost comparator for M_COST_RATIO and the honest work-avoided reference.

B-NOOP-STALE.description: Null comparator: serve inherited mirror knowledge unchanged, with no detection and no repair. It inherits (so it also pays no search), isolating the repair contribution from the inheritance contribution.
B-NOOP-STALE.role: proves the contamination/false-accept metrics can detect failure (NC-INSTRUMENT-SENSITIVITY); the inherit-without-repair ablation for the causal reading (SA-09).

B-FULL-REFRESH.description: Cost/containment extreme comparator: on the first detected change in an episode, refresh the ENTIRE mirror corpus (all 24 records over N=3 nodes); per-episode cost 75 L1 under the frozen cell-wise unit model (counter_definitions.full_refresh_unit_model), total 5400 L1, ratio 5.7692.
B-FULL-REFRESH.role: realises the no-localization/no-containment extreme; its mirror-cell mutation set (24) exceeds any blast radius (<=3) and is expected to fail F-CONTAIN, making that branch reachable.

B-LOCAL-ORACLE.description: Definitional floor: given the true delta and its class, serve the answer and apply only the minimal mirror mutations (1 retrieval + 1 verification + 1 write per episode; no detection, no search, no token).
B-LOCAL-ORACLE.role: establishes the cost floor; used by PC-COST-CANARY to prove the counter instrument has dynamic range. NOT a scientific arm.

PC-DETECT-CANARY.requirement: On a pre-registered fully-observable FIELD canary episode, T-LOCAL-DELTA-REPAIR must detect and repair the perturbation so that M_RECALL_FIELD on the canary == 1.0 and M_CANARY_PASS == true.
PC-DETECT-CANARY.why_it_is_a_real_control: A zero-recall treatment cannot be distinguished from an incapable instrument; the canary pins the instrument's ability to fire.

PC-COST-CANARY.requirement: On the same episode, M_COST_L1_B-COLD-REDERIVE must be strictly greater than M_COST_L1_B-LOCAL-ORACLE; M_COST_SEPARATION_PASS == true.
PC-COST-CANARY.why_it_is_a_real_control: Proves the counter instrument separates real re-derivation work from minimal work; without it a flat cost ratio cannot be interpreted.

PC-REPAIR-SEMANTICS.requirement: On a synthetic fixture where the treatment is handed the exact delta, its MIRROR-STORE state must be byte-equal (canonical JSON) to the independently computed ground-truth state; M_REPAIR_FIXTURE_PASS == true.
PC-REPAIR-SEMANTICS.why_it_is_a_real_control: A treatment that cannot even reproduce truth given the delta has a defective apply path; failure is a measurement failure, not a negative.

PC-FALSE-REPAIR-CANARY.requirement: On a pre-registered LEGIT canary episode with a token bump, the treatment's classifier must record a REFRESH (not a perturbation repair) and the false-repair metric must read M_FALSE_REPAIR_LEGIT == 0.0 on it, while the deterministic greedy witness trace (meta read skipped) must read 1.0 on the same fixture.
PC-FALSE-REPAIR-CANARY.why_it_is_a_real_control: Pins the false-repair metric's calibration in both directions before it gates a verdict.

NC-NOOP-NO-PERTURBATION.requirement: On the 9 NO_PERT episodes the treatment must make no mirror write that changes a cell away from truth (M_FALSE_REPAIR == 0 and M_CONTAMINATION == 0 on NO_PERT); a treatment that corrupts an unperturbed mirror cell has a defective base pipeline and the run is MEASUREMENT_INVALID.
NC-NOOP-NO-PERTURBATION.why: A treatment that corrupts without cause cannot be trusted to detect anything.

NC-INSTRUMENT-SENSITIVITY.requirement: On perturbed items B-NOOP-STALE must exhibit M_CONTAMINATION > 0.20 (probe witness 0.875; the metric detects failure), while B-COLD-REDERIVE must reach M_CONTAMINATION == 0 on the same items (the metric is not stuck).
NC-INSTRUMENT-SENSITIVITY.why: A metric that cannot read both failure and success controls nothing.

NC-FALSE-REPAIR-SENSITIVITY.requirement: A deterministic instrument fixture must show M_FALSE_REPAIR_LEGIT reading 0.0 on a clean labelled trace and 1.0 on the greedy (meta-skip) witness trace; a stuck metric is MEASUREMENT_INVALID.
NC-FALSE-REPAIR-SENSITIVITY.why: The false-repair metric is a SUPPORTS/FALSIFIES gate and must be proven to fire before use.

NC-VERIFIER-INDEPENDENCE.requirement: The independently recomputed true blast radius and ground-truth value set must exactly match the perturbation controller's retained pre/post registry snapshots; the verifier shares no localization code path with the treatment; the system under test never reads the controller ledger or the class/delta labels (V05); any mismatch or leak is terminal MEASUREMENT_INVALID.

NC-CONTAMINATION-BYTE-EXACT.requirement: Contamination, precision, recall, false-accept and false-repair are computed by byte-exact comparison to the independently recomputed ground truth, never from the treatment's self-report.
NC-CONTAMINATION-BYTE-EXACT.why: Prevents a treatment from manufacturing its own success criterion.

NC-WORLD-IMMUTABILITY.requirement: Across each episode window, every node registry file sha256 must be unchanged except by the perturbation controller's recorded mutations; any treatment-attributable world change is terminal MEASUREMENT_INVALID.
NC-WORLD-IMMUTABILITY.why: The object of repair is the mirror, not the world; if the treatment could write the world the measurement would be confounded (SA-10).

metrics.M_COST_RATIO: M_COST_L1_T-LOCAL-DELTA-REPAIR / M_COST_L1_B-COLD-REDERIVE (primary cost metric; lower is better).
metrics.M_COST_RATIO_UPPER: paired-bootstrap 95% upper bound of the per-episode L1 ratio (paired over the identical scored suite); a descriptive robustness device, not a significance test (deterministic policies, one seed).
metrics.M_COST_RATIO_WITH_WARMUP: sensitivity value including the one-time inheritance-acquisition cost in the numerator.
metrics.M_COST_L1_T-LOCAL-DELTA-REPAIR: sum of the four frozen counters for the treatment.
metrics.M_COST_L1_B-COLD-REDERIVE: sum of the four frozen counters for honest per-goal cold re-derivation.
metrics.M_COST_L1_B-LOCAL-ORACLE: sum of the four frozen counters for the definitional floor (dynamic-range reference).
metrics.M_COST_L1_B-FULL-REFRESH: sum of the four frozen counters for the full-refresh cost extreme (5400 L1 under the frozen cell-wise model).
metrics.M_CONTAMINATION: fraction of all 72 scored episodes where the SERVED MIRROR VALUE is byte-inexact versus independently recomputed ground truth; a deterministic census, so the point estimate is gated and no sampling CI is required (a Wilson interval is reported descriptively only).
metrics.M_FALSE_ACCEPT: fraction of scored items where the treatment serves or preserves a stale/incorrect mirror value while classifying it as a consistent/verified (non-UNKNOWN) state.
metrics.M_FALSE_ACCEPT_FIELD: per-family false-accept on the FIELD family (reported; the mandate requires per-family false-accept).
metrics.M_FALSE_ACCEPT_ENDPOINT: per-family false-accept on the ENDPOINT family.
metrics.M_FALSE_ACCEPT_TRANSPORT: per-family false-accept on the TRANSPORT family.
metrics.M_PRECISION_FIELD: CELL-based precision of the treatment's repair-classified mirror writes on the FIELD family = genuinely-changed cells written / total cells written on FIELD-family episodes (a rewrite of an already-correct cell counts as a false positive).
metrics.M_PRECISION_ENDPOINT: CELL-based precision on the ENDPOINT family.
metrics.M_PRECISION_TRANSPORT: CELL-based precision on the TRANSPORT family.
metrics.M_RECALL_FIELD: recall on the FIELD family (genuine FIELD perturbations served byte-exact / all FIELD perturbations, including the ambiguous CLS-A stratum).
metrics.M_FALSE_REPAIR: fraction of unperturbed (NO_PERT) mirror cells written away from truth.
metrics.M_FALSE_REPAIR_LEGIT: fraction of LEGIT (legitimate-update) episodes classified as requiring PERTURBATION REPAIR (a refresh-classified write is not a false repair); i.e. legitimate updates must not be mistaken for damage.
metrics.M_BLAST_RADIUS_CONTAINMENT: fraction of perturbations whose applied mirror-cell write set is a subset of the independently recomputed true blast radius.
metrics.M_CROSS_NODE_CONTAMINATION: fraction of perturbed episodes in which a mirror cell outside the true blast radius is written, or a node outside the true blast radius serves a byte-inexact value attributable to the perturbation.
metrics.M_UNKNOWN_RATE: fraction of episodes where the treatment abstains (UNKNOWN) instead of serving a classified answer.

ordered.condition: all blocking measurement-validity checks pass (V02-V09, V11) and all four positive controls pass and all six null controls are sensitive
ordered.consequence: no C-DELTA-REPAIR scientific statement; operational failure is not falsification (SB-08)

ordered.condition: M_COST_RATIO <= 0.70 AND M_COST_RATIO_UPPER < 1.0 AND M_CONTAMINATION <= 0.05 AND M_FALSE_ACCEPT <= 0.05 AND min(M_RECALL_FIELD, M_RECALL_ENDPOINT, M_RECALL_TRANSPORT) >= 0.90 AND min(M_PRECISION_FIELD, M_PRECISION_ENDPOINT, M_PRECISION_TRANSPORT) >= 0.80 AND M_FALSE_REPAIR_LEGIT <= 0.05 AND M_BLAST_RADIUS_CONTAINMENT == 1.0 AND M_CROSS_NODE_CONTAMINATION == 0.0
ordered.consequence: bounded local-repair capability measured on the controlled multi-node substrate; C-DELTA-REPAIR's next gate is measured (status remains HYPOTHESIS, DIRECTOR decides any change)
local repair saves no work versus honest per-goal cold re-derivation on this substrate

ordered.condition: M_CONTAMINATION > 0.20 OR min(M_RECALL_FIELD, M_RECALL_ENDPOINT, M_RECALL_TRANSPORT) < 0.50 OR min(M_PRECISION_FIELD, M_PRECISION_ENDPOINT, M_PRECISION_TRANSPORT) < 0.60 OR M_FALSE_REPAIR_LEGIT > 0.20
ordered.consequence: cost work is not reliable repair, or it destroys legitimate updates
repair is not locally contained on this substrate

ordered.condition: otherwise (0.70 < M_COST_RATIO < 1.0, OR M_COST_RATIO <= 0.70 with a quality/containment shortfall not severe enough for FALSIFIES-QUALITY/FALSIFIES-CONTAIN)
ordered.consequence: partial save or partial reliability; bounded report, no capability claim

decision_rule.branch_reachability: Proven reachable pre-freeze in spec.pre_freeze_satisfiability_dry_run (self-consistent arithmetic on the frozen metric definitions; not outcomes): SUPPORTS (witness cost_ratio 0.4808 with clean quality and perfect containment); FALSIFIES-COST (witness: a cold rank-clustered configuration at ratio 1.25, or B-FULL-REFRESH realising the structural extreme at ratio 5.7692); FALSIFIES-QUALITY (abstain/no-op contamination 0.875, greedy meta-skip false-repair 1.0, over-broad-localization precision 0.458); FALSIFIES-CONTAIN (B-FULL-REFRESH writes 24 mirror cells, containment 0.0); MIXED (cold space-7 ratio 0.7812 in the open interval, or a cost-win trace with M_FALSE_REPAIR_LEGIT 0.133). No branch is empty. The frozen support threshold 0.70 lies strictly inside the open interval (floor 0.2308, ceiling 5.7692).
decision_rule.determinism_note: Arms are deterministic policies under one frozen seed; the paired bootstrap is reported as a robustness device only, and no statistical-significance language is licensed by this design.

pre_freeze_satisfiability_dry_run.status: EXECUTED BY DESIGN on a stdlib probe only; NO substrate-under-test episode against the real treatment, NO confirmatory measurement, NO web, NO model, NO credential. It exercises the same counter arithmetic, decision thresholds and dynamic-range logic EXECUTE will freeze.
pre_freeze_satisfiability_dry_run.probe_artifact: /tmp/opencode/probe_38094114571.py (design-local; not a scored artifact; inline outputs recorded below)

component_A_substrate_feasibility.detail: Probe v2 started N=3 independent stdlib ThreadingHTTPServer loopback origins on ephemeral ports and performed 3 successful reads returning 3 distinct node identities (nodeA/nodeB/nodeC) on 3 distinct ports (36735, 37975, 39485); stdlib_only=true; requires_pip=false. This disproves the prior health-gate failure mode (EXP-GRAPH-36106653880) before EXECUTE exists. Probe v1 FAILED this check because it used a SHARED handler class attribute for node_id and all three origins answered 'nodeC' (identity smearing); probe v2 fixed identity to per-origin handler-class closures and PASSED (SA-14).

component_B_primitives.detail: src.spider.kernel imported successfully; _matches({'field':1},{'field':1,'extra':2})==true; _matches({'field':1},{'field':2})==false; _bind('users/${uid}',{'uid':'7'})=='users/7'; _template_slots({'p':'${uid}'})=={'uid'}; kernel.py sha256 46929b3a951df48d7f9d1fd850871073c0d91c1868aa117e13d389fe274e8d61 (the artifact bound in freeze_artifacts).

component_C_arithmetic.detail: Frozen honest unit model (witnesses, NOT predictions). L1 = http_requests + retrieval_calls + verification_calls + repair_attempts. Treatment (always-verify policy): base 3 per episode (1 mirror retrieval + 1 http + 1 verification); CLS-A = base + token(2) + repair(2) = 7; LEGIT = base + token(2) + refresh write/reverify(2) = 7; CLS-B = base + repair(2) + localization probes (distribution 9x1 + 3x2 + 3x3 = 24 probes); ENDPOINT = base + probe(1) + repair(2) = 6; TRANSPORT = base + forced revalidation(2) + repair(2) = 7; NO_PERT = base = 3. Totals: treatment L1 = 450; cold (space 12, expected rank 6.5, 2 per attempt) = 72*13 = 936; oracle floor = 72*3 = 216; B-FULL-REFRESH (cell-wise model: base 3 + 24 cells x (1 http + 1 verification + 1 write) = 75 per episode) = 72*75 = 5400. Ratio primary = 450/936 = 0.4808; with one-time inheritance acquisition (72) = 522/936 = 0.5577; oracle floor ratio = 0.2308; full-refresh ratio = 5400/936 = 5.7692. The support threshold 0.70 lies strictly inside the open interval (0.2308, 5.7692), so SUPPORTS is neither tautological nor unreachable. Cold-size sensitivity S=6..12: 0.8929, 0.7812, 0.6944, 0.6250, 0.5682, 0.5208, 0.4808.

component_C_bounds_non_vacuity.detail: Under the frozen metric definitions with n=72: a reachable SUPPORTS trace gives M_CONTAMINATION 0.0, M_FALSE_ACCEPT 0.0, min recall 1.0, min precision 1.0, M_FALSE_REPAIR_LEGIT 0.0. Reachable FAIL traces: B-NOOP-STALE / abstain contamination 0.875 (>0.20; 63 of 72 episodes = 48 perturbed + 15 LEGIT serve a byte-inexact mirror value), greedy meta-skip false-repair 1.0 (>0.20), over-broad-localization false-positive precision 0.458 (<0.60). Both regions of every gated bound are arithmetically reachable, so the bounds are non-vacuous and discriminating.

branch_reachability_matrix.GATE-V_MEASUREMENT_INVALID: reachable (substrate start failure, counter mismatch, verifier mismatch, class/delta leak, world immutability violation, liveness failure)
branch_reachability_matrix.SUPPORTS: reachable (witness cost_ratio 0.4808 with clean quality and perfect containment)
branch_reachability_matrix.FALSIFIES-QUALITY: reachable (abstain/no-op contamination 0.875; greedy false-repair 1.0; over-broad-localization precision 0.458)
branch_reachability_matrix.FALSIFIES-CONTAIN: reachable (B-FULL-REFRESH writes all 24 mirror cells, containment 0.0; or any out-of-radius write)

estimator_control_fixture.note: The primary cost metric uses a paired bootstrap over episodes; the analogous non-vacuity guarantee is the dynamic-range control PC-COST-CANARY (B-COLD-REDERIVE strictly above B-LOCAL-ORACLE) plus the contamination/false-repair PASS/FAIL witnesses above. Declared explicitly so AUDIT does not look for an unused estimator control.

self_attack_findings.finding: An earlier decision-rule draft's MIXED reachability check ignored the 'cost win but quality fails' subcase and reported MIXED unreachable.
self_attack_findings.resolution: MIXED redefined as 'otherwise', explicitly including cost_ratio<=0.70 with a quality/containment shortfall; witnesses recorded (cold space-7 ratio 0.7812; false-repair 0.133 with a cost win).

self_attack_findings.finding: The mandate names 'permission' as a blast-radius-1-3 change, but permission drift is structurally unreachable on a credential-free substrate.
self_attack_findings.resolution: PERMISSION declared NOT_APPLICABLE with reason SB-02; the nearest analogue (node-local capability flag governing field visibility) is a strict subset of ENDPOINT, so it is not admitted as a distinct family. No silent drop.

self_attack_findings.finding: A deterministic substrate that hands the treatment the exact delta collapses repair to the oracle (repair==truth, contamination==0), reproducing the EXP-GRAPH-36018188168 single-node definitional ceiling and making precision/recall trivial.
self_attack_findings.resolution: The treatment receives no class label and no round schedule; a classification-ambiguous CLS-A stratum and a LEGIT control family present the identical primary signal, resolvable only via a provenance token at bounded cost; the treatment therefore cannot sit at the oracle ceiling and the quality metrics are non-trivial.

self_attack_findings.finding: Any substrate requiring pip-installed Flask/PyJWT/gunicorn/nginx reproduces the EXP-GRAPH-36106653880 MEASUREMENT_INVALID health-gate failure.
self_attack_findings.resolution: Design fixed to stdlib-only loopback HTTP origins; a pre-freeze probe started 3 independent origins successfully without any install.

self_attack_findings.finding: Contamination/containment scored from treatment self-report would let the treatment define its own success.
self_attack_findings.resolution: Added NC-CONTAMINATION-BYTE-EXACT and NC-VERIFIER-INDEPENDENCE: an independent verifier recomputes ground truth and blast radius from retained pre/post registry snapshots by byte-exact comparison.

self_attack_findings.finding: The frozen numeric cost threshold 0.70 could have been set below the definitional floor, making SUPPORTS tautological, or above the ceiling, making it unreachable.
self_attack_findings.resolution: The probe fixes the oracle floor 0.2308 and the B-FULL-REFRESH ceiling 5.7692 with the threshold 0.70 strictly inside the open interval; both SUPPORTS (0.4808) and FALSIFIES-COST (>=1.0) are reachable.

self_attack_findings.finding: freeze_artifacts could not bind EXECUTE-written runner/substrate/verifier code because those files do not exist at freeze and the DESIGN write scope forbids creating them.
self_attack_findings.resolution: Rather than declare NOT_APPLICABLE, the design has a genuine pre-existing interpretation dependency: the frozen verification primitive src/spider/kernel.py (imported verbatim by both treatment and verifier). freeze_artifacts binds that exact file (freeze_artifacts_bound=PASS); the not-yet-existing EXECUTE code files are additionally enumerated in spec.code_binding and MUST be hashed into result.json.artifacts/provenance.json at EXECUTE. The residual scripts/ code-binding limitation is declared, not hidden.

self_attack_findings.finding: A comparator forced to re-derive the ENTIRE 24-record corpus for one goal is a strawman and makes the cost ratio near-definitional (b/R).
self_attack_findings.resolution: B-COLD-REDERIVE is an HONEST per-goal re-derivation: it discovers the minimal procedure+parameters for the SAME goal from the frozen 12-member candidate space and reads the value, exactly as an agent with no inheritance would. The comparison is discovery-vs-verification+repair, its magnitude is measured, and FALSIFIES-COST is behaviourally reachable.

self_attack_findings.finding: Conflating inheritance benefit with repair benefit could credit delta-repair for a work saving produced merely by inheriting a procedure.
self_attack_findings.resolution: B-NOOP-STALE is the inherit-without-repair ablation: same inheritance, no repair. The causal reading requires treatment to beat B-NOOP-STALE on contamination AND beat B-COLD-REDERIVE on cost, isolating the repair action; the savings decomposition is reported per family.

self_attack_findings.finding: OBJECT-OF-REPAIR CONTRADICTION: a treatment described as applying 'a mutation to the node registry' while V09 forbids exposing any write verb to the system under test is either writing the world (confounding 'repair' with 'overwrite truth') or structurally non-executable.
self_attack_findings.resolution: Explicit WORLD vs MIRROR-STORE separation: the world (node registries + router) is mutated ONLY by the perturbation controller; the treatment repairs its client-side mirror store (cells keyed node_id/record_id/field_id); the served answer is the reconciled mirror value; repair_attempts counts mirror writes; containment is measured in mirror-cell coordinates; NC-WORLD-IMMUTABILITY verifies the world is unchanged during each episode window; V09 states the GET-only/world-immutability requirement.

self_attack_findings.finding: A frozen unit model placing the SUPPORTS threshold 0.70 as a knife-edge (a treatment/cold ratio of ~0.702 under its own constants) makes SUPPORTS effectively unreachable under small modeling changes.
self_attack_findings.resolution: Recalibrated the frozen honest unit model (always-verify policy; candidate space 12; explicit per-family unit decomposition) giving a primary witness 0.4808 with a ~0.22 margin below the threshold, an oracle floor 0.2308, and a full-refresh ceiling 5.7692; the cold-size sensitivity S=6..12 is recorded so the branch set is demonstrably robust.

self_attack_findings.finding: The mandate explicitly requires per-family PRECISION as well as recall, but an earlier decision rule gated only recall; and a meta-skip misfire (the natural failure mode of the ambiguous stratum) had no FALSIFIES threshold even though it is the exact hazard the design creates.
self_attack_findings.resolution: SUPPORTS now requires min per-family precision >= 0.80; FALSIFIES-QUALITY now includes min per-family precision < 0.60 and M_FALSE_REPAIR_LEGIT > 0.20; the over-broad-localization witness (cell-based precision 0.458 = 33 changed cells / 72 written) and greedy witness (false-repair 1.0) prove both new failure regions are reachable, and PC-FALSE-REPAIR-CANARY / NC-FALSE-REPAIR-SENSITIVITY prove the metric fires before it gates a verdict.

self_attack_findings.finding: The closest pre-2.0 precedent (frontier-scoped-delta-repair) DID measure scoped-blind repair versus full relearning and locality/corruption on a deterministic synthetic shop, so a claim that 'no located pre-2.0 artifact measures repair versus re-derivation' would have been false.
self_attack_findings.resolution: legacy_distinctness enumerates the frontier-scoped-delta-repair pins (charter 4fe3e4a0042d5c0b28ee5bf554b4486c8eca4d65, PREREG.json 498a1649ae3ba6975ddc68903900fc63b0135882, derived 42a4c8c127b6509704a6da283b1127ff6251e554, verdict SURVIVES_CURRENT_TEST, PROOF_OF_CONCEPT ceiling) and states exactly what it measured versus what this experiment measures. DISTINCT_EXTENSION is retained on that honest basis.

self_attack_findings.finding: THIS experiment's probe v1 used a SHARED handler class attribute for per-origin node_id: all three loopback origins answered 'nodeC' (the last-instantiated class state), silently collapsing the multi-node identity that V02 and every per-node check depend on. A substrate built this way would either fail V02 as MEASUREMENT_INVALID or, worse, smear identities across nodes while health checks still pass.
self_attack_findings.resolution: probe v2 implements per-origin identity via handler-class closures (one class per origin node_id) and PASSED with 3 distinct identities on 3 distinct ports; the substrate spec (substrate.nodes.implementation and identity_surface) now mandates per-origin handler state and explicitly forbids a shared class attribute.

self_attack_findings.finding: The inherited full-refresh ceiling 3672 L1 (= refresh cost 48 per episode) contradicts the frozen counter definitions: refresh writes are repair_attempts (1 per cell) and fetches are http_requests, so a 24-cell refresh cannot cost only 48 L1 and omit all writes; the inconsistency made the ceiling smaller than the honest model.
self_attack_findings.resolution: counter_definitions.full_refresh_unit_model now decomposes B-FULL-REFRESH honestly per cell (1 http + 1 verification + 1 write = 3 L1) plus base 3, giving 75 L1 per episode and a 5400 L1 / 5.7692 ratio ceiling; the threshold 0.70 remains strictly inside (0.2308, 5.7692) and every branch witness still holds with the corrected ceiling.

pre_freeze_satisfiability_dry_run.no_outcome_claim: The probe measures no repair behaviour of the real treatment and cannot pre-empt the confirmatory objects (cost ratio, contamination, precision/recall, false-repair, containment). It only proves feasibility and arithmetic reachability.

measurement_validity.requirement: This spec and prereg.md are written before any substrate episode. DESIGN performed no confirmatory measurement: no substrate-under-test perturbation against the real treatment, no treatment evaluation. The only DESIGN computation is the synthetic stdlib satisfiability probe for this experiment.
measurement_validity.why: Research 2.0 packet contract and architecture section 5.

measurement_validity.requirement: At EXECUTE start, verify N=3 node origins are alive with DISTINCT node_id values (per-origin handler state, never a shared class attribute - SA-14), distinct registry paths and distinct loopback ports, and the router health endpoint returns a routed read; any failure is terminal MEASUREMENT_INVALID (not a scientific negative).
measurement_validity.why: The prior distributed failure was a health-gate infrastructure failure; fail closed, not open. Identity smearing would silently collapse multi-node identity.

measurement_validity.requirement: Retain pre/post registry sha256 for all nodes and independently recompute the true blast radius (mirror-cell set) and ground-truth value set; a verifier/treatment code-path mismatch is terminal MEASUREMENT_INVALID.
measurement_validity.why: Containment and contamination must rest on independently recomputed ground truth.

measurement_validity.requirement: Client-boundary counters are cross-checked against raw per-request logs; any discrepancy is terminal MEASUREMENT_INVALID.
measurement_validity.why: Cost is the primary metric; its instrument must be internally consistent.

measurement_validity.requirement: The system under test cannot read or write the perturbation controller's ledger or control channel (verified by isolation attestation); the treatment never receives the true delta or the family/class labels on the scored population.
measurement_validity.why: Otherwise the treatment could read the ground truth and collapse to the oracle.

measurement_validity.requirement: Retain all episode request/response records, per-node registry snapshots (pre/post every perturbation), mirror-store snapshots (pre/post every episode), counter logs and the independent ground-truth recomputation; the whole measurement must be re-analyzable without re-running.
measurement_validity.why: The prior distributed failure was unrecoverable because evidence was not retained.

measurement_validity.requirement: A single frozen seed (38094114571) drives all layout/scheduling/ambiguity/family assignment and rank assignment via random.Random(seed); Python process-randomized hash() is never used as a seed or layout key.

Re-verify request.json/spec.json/prereg.md/design_review.json against freeze.json sha256 before the first episode and after the last; re-verify src/spider/kernel.py against freeze.json.artifact_hashes; hash every producer source file into result.json.artifacts (role 'code') and provenance.json.

The substrate is local loopback only; every scored request is an idempotent GET; no credential, token, cookie, session, browser or external network is used; no write verb is exposed to the system under test, so the WORLD (node registries + router) is immutable by the system under test and can change only through the perturbation controller. Violation is terminal MEASUREMENT_INVALID.
measurement_validity.why: Keeps the substrate reproducible and independent of unavailable external services/credentials, and keeps 'repair of inherited knowledge' distinguishable from 'overwriting the world'.

measurement_validity.requirement: Each gated bound must have both a reachable PASS and a reachable FAIL region, documented in spec.pre_freeze_satisfiability_dry_run; the support threshold must lie strictly above the definitional floor and strictly below the full-refresh ceiling.
measurement_validity.why: Prevents a tautological or unreachable decision.

measurement_validity.requirement: Before scoring, the treatment must complete one canary episode end-to-end with a verifier-consistent repaired MIRROR state.
measurement_validity.why: A structurally non-executable treatment is a DESIGN/EXECUTE failure, not a scientific negative.

measurement_validity.requirement: Record explicitly that this experiment is a DISTINCT_EXTENSION from the pre-2.0 repair-round artifacts (rejected-run/orchestration repair), from the pre-2.0 frontier-scoped-delta-repair program (action-budget repair-vs-full-relearn on one deterministic synthetic shop, PROOF_OF_CONCEPT ceiling), from the prior R2 single-node and distributed delta-repair packets, and from the three never-frozen predecessor DESIGN attempts (EXP-GRAPH-38046502943, EXP-GRAPH-38085175893, EXP-GRAPH-38087579015) that died at the design-review control plane.
measurement_validity.why: Prevents re-running an identical or already-closed design.

It is the ONLY pre-existing mutable local dependency on which the interpretation rests.

Those files do not exist at freeze time and the DESIGN write scope forbids DESIGN from creating them, so they cannot be listed in spec.freeze_artifacts (the freezer rejects non-existent paths). This residual code-binding limitation (the defect lives in scripts/, outside every lane's allowed_code_roots) is declared. The pre-existing verification primitive src/spider/kernel.py IS bound now.
code_binding.at_execute_also_reuse_unchanged: The frozen request.json/spec.json/prereg.md/design_review.json, the frozen seed 38094114571, and src/spider/kernel.py; no external data.

decision_rule_reachability.reason: Every ordered branch is reachable and non-empty, proven in spec.pre_freeze_satisfiability_dry_run: SUPPORTS (witness cost_ratio 0.4808 with clean quality), FALSIFIES-COST (cold rank-clustered ratio 1.25; B-FULL-REFRESH ratio 5.7692), FALSIFIES-QUALITY (contamination 0.875; false-repair 1.0; over-broad-localization precision 0.458), FALSIFIES-CONTAIN (B-FULL-REFRESH containment 0.0), MIXED (cold space-7 ratio 0.7812; or false-repair 0.133 with a cost win). GATE-V is reachable via the enumerated validity failures. The support threshold 0.70 lies strictly above the oracle floor 0.2308 and below the full-refresh ceiling 5.7692, so SUPPORTS is neither tautological nor unreachable. Self-attacks SA-01, SA-08, SA-11, SA-12 and SA-15 fixed MIXED mis-specification, the definitional comparator, the knife-edge calibration, the missing precision/false-repair failure regions and the inconsistent full-refresh ceiling.

measurement_prerequisites.reason: All prerequisites exist now and are local: CPython 3.12 stdlib only (no Flask/PyJWT/nginx/gunicorn/SQLite/pip install), loopback networking, ephemeral ports, and the frozen verification primitive. The DESIGN probe for THIS experiment already started N=3 independent stdlib loopback origins with per-origin identity (3 reads, 3 distinct identities nodeA/nodeB/nodeC on 3 distinct ports) and imported/executed the kernel primitives, so the substrate class and the treatment's verification semantics are proven available before freeze. No external network, model, credential, browser, task bank or dataset is required. The treatment-liveness smoke test (V11) is a pre-scoring smoke, not a deferred prerequisite for the design's satisfiability.

baseline_identifiability.reason: The compared pair is identifiable and not collapsed: B-COLD-REDERIVE is an HONEST per-goal re-derivation (discovers the goal's procedure from the frozen 12-member candidate space and reads the value) and the treatment inherits that procedure and pays detection+classification+repair; the two differ in a measured quantity, not by construction of R/b. B-LOCAL-ORACLE (floor ratio 0.2308) and B-FULL-REFRESH (ceiling ratio 5.7692) bracket the dynamic range, and PC-COST-CANARY requires cold strictly above oracle, so the primary metric has non-zero variance and range. The treatment is deliberately kept below the correctness oracle by the classification-ambiguous CLS-A stratum and by the token cost, and B-NOOP-STALE isolates the inheritance-without-repair ablation so the repair contribution is identified. The object of repair is unambiguous (mirror cells; the world is immutable by the SUT, NC-WORLD-IMMUTABILITY), so 'repair' cannot collapse into 'overwrite the world'.

control_sensitivity.reason: Every control has a pre-declared firing/abstaining outcome and pre-declared pass/fail arithmetic computed by the SAME treatment/counter code that scores the question: PC-DETECT-CANARY requires canary recall == 1.0; PC-COST-CANARY requires cold > oracle strictly; PC-REPAIR-SEMANTICS requires byte-equal mirror state on a given-delta fixture; PC-FALSE-REPAIR-CANARY requires the false-repair metric to read 0.0 on a clean LEGIT trace and 1.0 on the greedy trace; NC-NOOP-NO-PERTURBATION requires no truth-changing write on NO_PERT; NC-INSTRUMENT-SENSITIVITY requires B-NOOP-STALE contamination > 0.20 AND B-COLD-REDERIVE contamination == 0 on the same items; NC-FALSE-REPAIR-SENSITIVITY requires the false-repair metric to fire in both directions on a synthetic fixture; NC-VERIFIER-INDEPENDENCE requires an exact independent recompute and code-path separation; NC-WORLD-IMMUTABILITY requires registry sha stability. Both PASS and FAIL regions of every bound are arithmetically reachable (component_C_bounds_non_vacuity). The controls are not tautological: they operate on canary/legitimate/synthetic fixtures with pre-declared expectations.

treatment_liveness.reason: The decision-relevant treatment T-LOCAL-DELTA-REPAIR is a concrete, executable program: look up the mirror cell, fetch+verify the goal via src.spider.kernel._matches/_bind, localize the minimal mirror cell set, read the token when the signal is ambiguous, rewrite only those mirror cells, re-verify. Design proven satisfiable: the probe demonstrated the substrate the treatment needs (3 independent stdlib origins with per-origin identity, 3 successful reads) and the exact verification primitives (_matches/_bind/_template_slots) it will use. V11 mandates a pre-scoring liveness smoke test; a structurally non-executable treatment is a DESIGN/EXECUTE failure (MEASUREMENT_INVALID), not a scientific result. No branch of the decision rule is structurally empty for the treatment. The object-of-repair contradiction (which could have made the treatment non-executable against a GET-only world) is resolved by the explicit mirror-store semantics (SA-10), and identity smearing is ruled out (SA-14).

freeze_artifacts_bound.reason: The interpretation rests on exactly one pre-existing mutable local dependency: the verification/binding primitive src/spider/kernel.py (sha256 46929b3a951df48d7f9d1fd850871073c0d91c1868aa117e13d389fe274e8d61), which both the treatment and the independent verifier MUST import and use verbatim (_matches, _bind, _template_slots). The only remaining mutable dependencies are the EXECUTE-authored producer files (runner, substrate, perturbation controller/verifier, fixtures), which do not exist at freeze because the DESIGN write scope (scripts/check_scope.py stage 'design') allows only spec.json/prereg.md/design_review.json/failure.json/model_design.json/model_design_review.json and forbids creating code; scripts/freeze_experiment.py.safe_repo_file rejects non-existent paths, so they cannot be listed. This residual code-binding limitation is declared rather than hidden (SA-07).

product_consequence_positive: If SUPPORTS: C-DELTA-REPAIR's registry next gate ('controlled local perturbations with repair cost and contamination bounds') is measured on a multi-node substrate for the first time in R2, giving the Product/Runtime lanes a bounded, auditable work-avoided ratio versus honest per-goal cold re-derivation, an explicit contamination/false-accept envelope, a per-family precision/recall profile, and a false-repair rate for legitimate updates. This is decision-relevant input to whether delta-repair instrumentation is worth building at all. It does NOT by itself authorize any Product Core promotion, shipping, or status change (SB-05); the DIRECTOR decides bounded status movement from the frozen packet plus independent audit.
product_consequence_negative: If FALSIFIES or MIXED: the Product/Runtime lanes learn that on a controlled credential-free multi-node substrate, local delta repair either saves no work versus honest cold re-derivation (FALSIFIES-COST), is not reliable enough to be a safeguard or destroys legitimate updates (FALSIFIES-QUALITY), or is not locally contained (FALSIFIES-CONTAIN). That is a decisive negative for funding a delta-repair mechanism on the strength of the prior single-node positive, and it redirects effort away from repair instrumentation toward the already-identified critical path (the shipped parameterized carrier / non-degenerate benchmark). A MEASUREMENT_INVALID result carries NO scientific consequence and must be fixed at the control-plane/substrate level, not read as a repair negative (SB-08).
estimated_cost: Low. Stdlib-only, loopback-only, no model/browser/credential/network: 72 scored episodes x 2 primary arms plus 3 control baselines and fixtures, all in-process. Indicative compute is well under one CPU-minute and a few MB of raw JSON evidence; the main cost is EXECUTE implementation effort, not runtime or external spend.
expected_information_gain: HIGH and decision-changing: it converts C-DELTA-REPAIR's unmeasured registry next gate into a first controlled multi-node measurement with honest counters, an independent verifier, per-family precision/recall, a false-repair metric for legitimate updates, and reachable SUPPORTS/FALSIFIES/MIXED branches. A SUPPORTS result justifies building delta-repair instrumentation; a FALSIFIES result closes the prior single-node positive as non-transferable and redirects effort to the critical path. Either way the outcome changes a product decision, and the design removes the known degeneracies (single-node oracle ceiling; definitional whole-corpus comparator; shared-substrate identity smearing; inconsistent full-refresh counter model) plus the object-of-repair contradiction.
design_improvements_over_predecessor: Primary comparator is an HONEST per-goal cold re-derivation over a frozen 12-member candidate procedure space with first-success stopping, so the measured cost ratio reflects a real discovery-vs-verification+repair trade and FALSIFIES-COST is behaviourally reachable (SA-08).

Explicit WORLD vs MIRROR-STORE object-of-repair separation removes the object-of-repair contradiction between 'applies a mutation to the node registry' and the V09 GET-only/no-write-verb requirement, and adds NC-WORLD-IMMUTABILITY (SA-10).
